newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steers or heifers sold for a market test, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand very light.
Sales confirmed on 300 slaughter steers and 300 slaughter heifers early Monday. For the week to date including late Friday and over the weekend on 5,800 head.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1300-1325 lbs 66.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1075 lbs 66.00.
Wk to date - 5,800 last week - 12,600 last year - 17,500
